questions.stem: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explanation: “gender” có “g” đọc /dʒ/; “gap”, “give”, “goal” đọc /ɡ/.

questions.stem: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explanation: “promoted” tận cùng âm /t/ nên “-ed” đọc /ɪd/; “encouraged”, “allowed”, “joined” đọc /d/.

questions.stem: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: “career” /kəˈrɪə/ nhấn âm 2; “equal”, “female”, “household” nhấn âm 1.

questions.stem: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: “economic” /ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk/ nhấn âm 3; “equality” /iˈkwɒləti/, “development” /dɪˈveləpmənt/, “discriminate” /dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Gender ______ means that men and women have the same rights and opportunities.
questions.explanation: Sau “gender” cần danh từ tạo cụm “gender equality” (bình đẳng giới).

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
No one should be treated unfairly. Discrimination ______ women in the workplace must be stopped.
questions.explanation: Cụm “discrimination against sb” = sự phân biệt đối xử với ai.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Today many women are able to pursue a ______ in fields such as engineering and medicine.
questions.explanation: “pursue a career” = theo đuổi sự nghiệp; salary/wage/income là tiền lương, thu nhập, không đi với “pursue”.

questions.topic: Unit 7: Viet Nam and international organisations – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Viet Nam became a ______ of the United Nations in 1977.
questions.explanation: Sau “a” và trước “of” cần danh từ đếm được: member (thành viên). Việt Nam gia nhập Liên Hợp Quốc năm 1977.

questions.topic: Unit 7: Viet Nam and international organisations – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The World Bank lends money to developing countries to help them reduce ______ and improve living standards.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ “reduce” cần danh từ: poverty (sự nghèo đói).

questions.topic: Unit 7: Viet Nam and international organisations – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Viet Nam has ______ a lot from joining the World Trade Organization, especially in trade and investment.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc “benefit from sth” = hưởng lợi từ điều gì; các động từ còn lại không hợp nghĩa với “from”.

questions.topic: Unit 8: New ways to learn – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
In a ______ classroom, students watch video lectures at home and then do exercises and discussions in class.
questions.explanation: “flipped classroom” (lớp học đảo ngược): xem bài giảng ở nhà, luyện tập, thảo luận trên lớp.

questions.topic: Unit 8: New ways to learn – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
With an Internet connection, students can ______ online learning materials at any time.
questions.explanation: “access materials” = truy cập tài liệu; “connect” cần “to”, “approach/reach” không hợp nghĩa.

questions.topic: Unit 6 – Grammar: Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Women ______ equal pay for equal work.
questions.explanation: Phụ nữ “được trả” → bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: should + be + V3 → should be given.

questions.topic: Unit 6 – Grammar: Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Gender inequality ______ by changing people's attitudes and traditional beliefs.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ “gender inequality” chịu tác động → can + be + V3: can be solved.

questions.topic: Unit 6 – Grammar: Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Girls ______ to study science and technology subjects as much as boys.
questions.explanation: Các em gái “được khuyến khích” → must + be + V3: must be encouraged.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Viet Nam's economy is growing ______ than it was twenty years ago.
questions.explanation: Có “than” → so sánh hơn; “fast” là từ ngắn → faster.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
UNICEF is one of ______ organisations that help children around the world.
questions.explanation: “one of + the + so sánh nhất + danh từ số nhiều”; “famous” là tính từ dài → the most famous.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
This year's youth conference was ______ than last year's because more countries took part.
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ dài: more successful; nhấn mạnh bằng “much” đặt trước “more”; không dùng “very” với so sánh hơn.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The teacher ______ taught us English last year has moved to Ha Noi.
questions.explanation: Thay cho danh từ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ của mệnh đề quan hệ → who.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
My school, ______ was built in 1990, has just introduced blended learning.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy), thay cho vật, làm chủ ngữ → which; không dùng “that” sau dấu phẩy; “where” không làm chủ ngữ.

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Nam: “Could you tell me what UNICEF does?”
Mai: “______”
options: Sure. It's a UN agency that works for children's rights.
questions.explanation: Đáp lại lời nhờ cung cấp thông tin bằng cách trả lời trực tiếp nội dung được hỏi.

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Lan: “I think women should be paid the same as men for the same job.”
Hung: “______”
questions.explanation: Đáp lại một ý kiến → bày tỏ đồng tình: “I totally agree with you.” Các phương án còn lại dùng để cảm ơn/ nhận lời mời.

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Lan: That sounds convenient. Is it difficult?
b. Minh: I'm taking an online English course.
c. Lan: What are you doing this summer, Minh?
d. Minh: Not really. I can study at my own pace.
questions.explanation: Lan hỏi kế hoạch hè (c) → Minh trả lời học khóa tiếng Anh online (b) → Lan nhận xét và hỏi có khó không (a) → Minh trả lời “Not really…” (d).

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. Since then, it has actively taken part in many UN programmes.
b. Viet Nam joined the United Nations in 1977.
c. For example, Vietnamese officers and doctors have joined UN peacekeeping missions since 2014.
d. Thanks to these contributions, Viet Nam has gained respect from the international community.
questions.explanation: Câu chủ đề (b) nêu sự kiện gia nhập → “Since then” (a) nối tiếp → ví dụ “For example” (c) → kết luận “Thanks to these contributions” (d).

questions.topic: Reading comprehension (Unit 8: New ways to learn)
questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Technology has changed the way students learn. In the past, learning mainly took place in classrooms, where teachers gave lectures and students took notes. Today, thanks to the Internet and digital devices, students can learn almost anywhere and at any time.

One popular model is blended learning, which combines face-to-face lessons with online activities. Students meet their teachers at school a few times a week and complete the rest of their work online. Another model is the flipped classroom. In this model, students watch short video lectures at home before class. Class time is then used for discussions, group projects and practice exercises, so teachers can give more support to students who need it.

These new ways of learning have many advantages. Students can study at their own pace and review difficult lessons as many times as they want. They also become more independent and learn how to manage their time. However, online learning also has some drawbacks. Some students find it hard to concentrate when they study alone at home, and others do not have a reliable Internet connection. Moreover, spending too much time in front of screens may harm their eyes.

In conclusion, new ways of learning can be very effective, but students need self-discipline and good support from teachers and parents to benefit from them.

What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to buy digital devices for students
Why teachers should stop giving lectures
New ways of learning and their advantages and disadvantages
questions.explanation: Bài giới thiệu blended learning, flipped classroom rồi nêu ưu và nhược điểm → nói về các cách học mới cùng ưu, nhược điểm.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
Singapore is (A) one of the (B) most richest countries (C) in Southeast Asia, (D) and it is a founding member of ASEAN.
questions.explanation: “rich” là tính từ ngắn → so sánh nhất là “richest”, không thêm “most”: most richest → richest.

questions.topic: Error identification – Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
Equal pay (A) for men and women (B) must (C) be (D) guarantee by law.
questions.explanation: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: must be + V3 → guarantee → guaranteed.

questions.topic: Sentence transformation – Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
We must protect women's rights at work.
options: Women's rights at work must be protecting.
Women's rights at work must be protected.
Women's rights at work must protect.
Women's rights at work were protected.
questions.explanation: Chuyển sang bị động giữ động từ khuyết thiếu: must + be + V3 → must be protected; “were protected” sai thì và mất nghĩa “phải”.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
I met a woman. Her daughter teaches at an online school.
options: I met a woman whose daughter teaches at an online school.
I met a woman which daughter teaches at an online school.
I met a woman whom daughter teaches at an online school.
I met a woman who's daughter teaches at an online school.
questions.explanation: “Her daughter” chỉ sự sở hữu → dùng “whose + danh từ”; “who's” = who is.
